title: Full multimodal live acceptance upgrade

context.summary: Upgrade local-model acceptance to cover all v0.1.1 supported multimodal paths.
context.background: The supported multimodal release must be gated by live fixture processing, search, source refs, job status and audit verification.

in: Extend pnpm local-model:acceptance for text, scanned PDF OCR, image OCR, image captioning, object detection, image vectors, audio ASR, video keyframes through image handlers, face matching, image generation and audio generation.
Verify artifacts, source refs, jobs, audit logs, metrics and search results.
Keep dry-run mode CI-safe and live mode explicit.
Document required resources and timeout controls.
out: Changing provider implementations beyond acceptance fixes.

acceptance_criteria: Dry-run acceptance verifies the full scenario wiring without Docker side effects.
Live acceptance processes all supported fixtures through selected local profiles.
Search returns expected metadata, source refs, vector-backed results and face matches.
Model-operation audit and metrics include every exercised role.

manual_checks: Run MINDORY_LOCAL_MODEL_ACCEPTANCE_LIVE=true pnpm local-model:acceptance on Docker.
Confirm live logs show every promoted role executed.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
